adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb` under `context ".remove_member"`, the first test calls `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42`, but the route added in `config/routes.rb` maps `remove_member` to `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` (DELETE), not PUT. Controller specs can still hit the action directly, so it may pass, but it doesn't exercise the real HTTP verb/route combination and could hide routing/verb issues.
